name: @homeloanexpress/cal-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Cal — the AI mortgage platform from HomeLoanExpress. Exposes the Cal lender library, DPA programs, lender intel, and authoritative loan-limit / fee facts to any MCP-compatible client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Continue, Goose, Zed). First mortgage MCP server with a real lender data moat: 166+ lenders, 1,400+ indexed documents, 250+ DPA programs, all 50 states.
